objective: Read the two rings of the map of S6 of type (6,6), genus 61, that RESCUE-GENUS-20261109-001A found rescued by counts 2, 2 and 3: list their shortest routes and test, by homology mod 2 of the loops two routes make, whether they run round different handles.
status: Proved 2026-11-09 (exact reading): the S6 map of type (6,6), genus 61, the one on-time map of 1,762 that rescues a ring by an odd count of several routes, has two such rings, exchanged by the half-turn about the target, each with three closest contacts at distance 9 reached by 2, 3 and 2 routes; every pair of these routes runs round a different handle (loops not null-homologous mod 2), so the count 3 is three lifts of the target at one distance.
title: The S6 exception is a three-way tie between lifts
